results.sources_checked: FINDING VERIFIED. Weval (Collective Intelligence Project) aggregate model card 'GROK-4', https://weval.org/cards/grok-4, page footer 'Updated 8/17/2025', overall score 82.5%, 24 runs / 24 blueprints. Card re-fetched 2026-08-29; the finding quote is character-exact on the page: 'Its baseline behavior can lead to providing harmful information or failing to adequately redirect users in suicidal ideation scenarios'. Its full sentence context was also verified: 'Using Grok-4 for mental health crisis intervention without extremely robust and explicit system prompts is a significant safety risk.' and '... as evidenced in Mental Health Safety & Global Nuance and Stanford HAI Mental Health Safety & Global Nuance.' Company identified as xAI from models_systems ('Grok-4 (xAI)'; card lists variant 'xai:grok-4-0709'). TOOLING NOTE: this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) before this row. DuckDuckGo (html and lite) returned HTTP 202 empty, Mojeek 403, Brave 429, Startpage a 142-byte stub, and Bing returned bot-degraded spam results (casino/calculator pages) for every query including controls; https://web.archive.org was refused at the socket (Errno 61) although http://web.archive.org and http://archive.org worked. Searching was therefore done by direct crawling of xAI primary sources with the repo fetch helper, plus the Wayback CDX/availability APIs, Google News RSS, GDELT, OpenAlex, Hansard API, gov.uk search API, Federal Register API and HN Algolia. We also employ model-based filters for both Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web, which reject classes of harmful requests, including biological and chemical weapons, self-harm, and CSAM.' - repeated near-verbatim in the Grok 4 Fast and Grok 4.1 cards.
